notes.title: Alpha 0.0.2 Released
notes.content:
Hey! 

I just released alpha-0.0.2. This update is available for all the play testers and to all the Discord memebers which wanted to be part of the closed alpha playtest.

Here is the list of fixes and updates that have been released:

- [b]Fix movement on belt[/b]. The first alpha highlited that items on belt were moving depending on the FPS (framerate) the game was running at. I updated this to be framerate independent.

- [b]Fix building and belts overlap[/b]. When any buildable object cannot be placed in a specific location, either because there is another object opr because it is on water,. The UI will color the building red and prevent the placing.

- [b]Added manual multiplayer[/b]. I added new UI panels to allow the players to start a new multiplayer session and to join a pre-existing session. For player which will join mid-game, the state of the session will be synched and all players will always see the same state of their factories.

- [b]Improvesd Miner machine[/b]: Miners will now extract resources from the terrain and consume ores deposits within a 4x4 area. Also updated the mining rate to 1 ore mined every 2sec.

- [b]Improved buildable objects placement[/b]: During the alpha-0.0.1 playtest multiple players raised issues of placing object wasn't enough precise and reliable. Work has been done to improve that mechanics feeling.

Hope you will like this update. Any issue / question, please raise on the official Discord!
